summary: Teekay Corporation Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing Q1 2026 results and a special cash dividend of $1.00 per share, payable June 2, 2026 to holders of record on May 26, 2026. This is an issuer-initiated capital return to shareholders. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The dividend is a direct cash distribution, implying a total payout of approximately $87 million based on 87 million shares outstanding. Watch for potential future capital return announcements or changes in dividend policy.
